sentences.hanzi: 中秋节快到了，丽丽和弟弟小明一起帮妈妈做月饼。 妈妈准备好了面粉、糖和红豆。 丽丽对小明说：“弟弟，我们先洗手，再开始做月饼。” 小明说：“好的，姐姐，我要做一个小兔子月饼。” 他们开始做月饼。 妈妈把面团分成几个小块。 丽丽拿了一个小块，用手压一压，然后放一点红豆在里面。 她把面团包起来，再用手轻轻地揉一揉，做成了一个圆圆的月饼。 小明也拿了一个小块，他先压一压，然后放红豆。 可是他想做小兔子，就把面团捏成了小兔子的样子。 丽丽看了看，笑着说：“小明，你的小兔子很可爱，但是月饼应该是圆圆的。” 小明说：“姐姐，我明白了，我再做一个圆圆的月饼。” 丽丽教他怎么把月饼做得圆圆的。 她说：“你要用手心轻轻地转圈，这样月饼就会变圆。” 小明跟着姐姐做，慢慢地，他也做出了一个圆圆的月饼。 妈妈把月饼放进烤箱里。 过了一会儿，月饼烤好了，很香。 晚上，一家人坐在院子里，一边吃月饼，一边看圆圆的月亮。 小明说：“今天的月亮真圆，像我们的月饼一样。” 丽丽说：“是啊，中秋节就是一家人团圆的日子。” 大家都笑了，这个中秋节过得很开心。
sentences.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié kuài dào le, Lìlì hé dìdi Xiǎomíng yīqǐ bāng māma zuò yuèbǐng. Māma zhǔnbèi hǎo le miànfěn, táng hé hóngdòu. Lìlì duì Xiǎomíng shuō: "Dìdi, wǒmen xiān xǐshǒu, zài kāishǐ zuò yuèbǐng." Xiǎomíng shuō: "Hǎo de, jiějie, wǒ yào zuò yī gè xiǎo tùzi yuèbǐng." Tāmen kāishǐ zuò yuèbǐng. Māma bǎ miàntuán fēn chéng jǐ gè xiǎo kuài. Lìlì ná le yī gè xiǎo kuài, yòng shǒu yā yī yā, ránhòu fàng yīdiǎn hóngdòu zài lǐmiàn. Tā bǎ miàntuán bāo qǐlái, zài yòng shǒu qīngqīng de róu yī róu, zuò chéng le yī gè yuányuán de yuèbǐng. Xiǎomíng yě ná le yī gè xiǎo kuài, tā xiān yā yī yā, ránhòu fàng hóngdòu. Kěshì tā xiǎng zuò xiǎo tùzi, jiù bǎ miàntuán niē chéng le xiǎo tùzi de yàngzi. Lìlì kàn le kàn, xiào zhe shuō: "Xiǎomíng, nǐ de xiǎo tùzi hěn kě'ài, dànshì yuèbǐng yīnggāi shì yuányuán de." Xiǎomíng shuō: "Jiějie, wǒ míngbai le, wǒ zài zuò yī gè yuányuán de yuèbǐng." Lìlì jiāo tā zěnme bǎ yuèbǐng zuò de yuányuán de. Tā shuō: "Nǐ yào yòng shǒuxīn qīngqīng de zhuàn quān, zhèyàng yuèbǐng jiù huì biàn yuán." Xiǎomíng gēn zhe jiějie zuò, mànmàn de, tā yě zuò chū le yī gè yuányuán de yuèbǐng. Māma bǎ yuèbǐng fàng jìn kǎoxiāng lǐ. Guò le yīhuìr, yuèbǐng kǎo hǎo le, hěn xiāng. Wǎnshang, yī jiā rén zuò zài yuànzi lǐ, yībiān chī yuèbǐng, yībiān kàn yuányuán de yuèliang. Xiǎomíng shuō: "Jīntiān de yuèliang zhēn yuán, xiàng wǒmen de yuèbǐng yīyàng." Lìlì shuō: "Shì a, Zhōngqiūjié jiù shì yī jiā rén tuányuán de rìzi." Dàjiā dōu xiào le, zhège Zhōngqiūjié guò de hěn kāixīn.
sentences.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival was approaching, and Lili and her younger brother Xiaoming helped their mother make mooncakes. Mom had prepared flour, sugar, and red bean paste. Lili said to Xiaoming, "Little brother, let's wash our hands first before we start making mooncakes." Xiaoming said, "Okay, big sister, I want to make a little rabbit mooncake." They started making mooncakes. Mom divided the dough into several small pieces. Lili took a small piece, pressed it with her hand, and then put a little red bean paste inside. She wrapped the dough around it, gently rolled it with her hands, and made a round mooncake. Xiaoming also took a small piece. He pressed it first, then put in red bean paste. But he wanted to make a little rabbit, so he shaped the dough into a little rabbit. Lili looked at it and said with a smile, "Xiaoming, your little rabbit is very cute, but mooncakes should be round." Xiaoming said, "Big sister, I understand now. I'll make another round mooncake." Lili taught him how to make the mooncake round. She said, "You need to gently turn it in circles with your palms, and then the mooncake will become round." Xiaoming followed his sister and slowly made a round mooncake too. Mom put the mooncakes into the oven. After a while, the mooncakes were baked and smelled very good. In the evening, the family sat in the courtyard, eating mooncakes and looking at the round moon. Xiaoming said, "The moon is really round today, just like our mooncakes." Lili said, "Yes, the Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for family reunion." Everyone laughed, and this Mid-Autumn Festival was very happy.
